Both Kings 8:53a targets were read with the complete continuation paragraph about dwelling in gloom, building the house and the Book of Song. The rationales accurately identify a temple saying connection without suppressing the additions or different placement.

The Psalm 131 wording about rest, ark, priestly clothing and the anointed one supplies specific liturgical connections under the source numbering; differences in strength/holiness, salvation/righteousness and sons/holy ones remain visible.
Seven-day celebration, eighth-day closing or dismissal, and twenty-third-of-the-seventh-month dismissal are compared without constructing a harmonized calendar.

Same-chapter rows are explicitly labeled and connect an identified temple furnishing to its function, specific building works to their construction summary, or obedience to the immediately stated service arrangements. They are more specific than shared vocabulary alone.

Reversed city transfers, distinct supervisory totals, sea-voyage gold totals, timber uses, gold display objects and units, and cargo lists remain distinct. Categories state comparison or contrast where appropriate.

Actual Kings suffixed units and complete death/succession text are respected. The southern-allegiance comparison to Kings 12:24u does not equate Judah-city Israelites with the separate Judah-and-Benjamin description.
